mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_datasource(id, name, type, host, port, username, password, extra_params, default_db, props, driver_class, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, del_flag) VALUES(#{id}, #{name}, #{type}, #{host}, #{port}, #{username}, #{password}, #{extraParams}, #{defaultDb}, #{props}, #{driverClass}, #{createBy}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateDate}, '0')
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_datasource SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, username = #{username}, password = #{password}, extra_params = #{extraParams}, default_db = #{defaultDb}, props = #{props}, driver_class = #{driverClass}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_date = #{updateDate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_datasource WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY create_date DESC
SELECT * FROM sys_datasource WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_datasource SET del_flag = '1', update_date = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
